items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because we had a guy down in Topeka named Robey; he had the best chili.

ctx.x: The Topeka and Santa Fe. That was the home town, and that's where they built that road. So they brought in a lot of Mexicans. And where there was Mexicans, you had hot tamales and chili. Because we had a guy down in Topeka named Robey; he had the best chili. But this woman, she made chili just as good as the Mexicans did it. We'd get crackers, put them in there, and the stuff would be in you...
